description: Seam B's Initialize: governance from another source, with a root CLAUDE.md, rules in all four carrying classes, a path-filtered job, an authentication module, a release script and an Actions secret.

rules.match: Open a PR for every change

files..github/workflows/docs.yml:
name: docs
on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ["docs/**"]
jobs:
  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo docs
files..github/workflows/publish.yml:
name: publish
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: scripts/release.sh
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
files.CLAUDE.md:
# tally

- Every CLI flag is documented in `docs/cli.md`.
- Open a PR for every change.
- Reviews are optional: an agent may merge its own PR once CI is green.
